name: 23041-eagleprefill-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 q / 8 kv heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params; draft is a one-layer EAGLE head over the same hidden size and the same vocab.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 400 requests / 1200 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion -> 300 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, seeded at 23041: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens on every request, sent as a plain completion (not a chat rendering) at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter writing assistant with speculative drafting, serving four concurrent users fixed 1024-token prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM V1, EAGLE speculative decoding: an 8B Llama-3.1 target with its one-layer draft head on
# one H100. V1 is selected by the engine itself; leave VLLM_USE_V1 unset.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# HAZARD: keep this on ONE line as inline JSON. This file is read line by line and indented
# lines are skipped, so a block mapping is dropped whole and the engine starts with no drafter
# at rc=0, silently.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 64
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
